# Asclepius

> Connected care, explained: a browser-only educational demo for healthcare stakeholders exploring synthetic workflows, with a separate local TypeScript/FHIR teaching core.

NOT_FOR_CLINICAL_USE. Fictional examples only. Do not use real patient data or interpret validation as clinical safety or full FHIR conformance. The local drug-interaction knowledge base is intentionally incomplete.

Two cases, each with nine records: Alex Morgan's routine follow-up and Maya Chen's referral from Willow to Cedar. In Maya's fixed snapshot the referral is active, coordination is completed, and the receiving visit is planned. Navigating stages does not send referrals or change care status. The browser demo makes no API calls and needs no account.

## Explore

- [Review Maya’s referral](https://safetymp.github.io/Asclepius/): inspect Cedar’s evidence, cite the request, and compare onboarding approaches.
- [Technical evidence](https://safetymp.github.io/Asclepius/workspace/): trace the selected case, replay filing and correction, and test the shared validator.
- [Sitemap](https://safetymp.github.io/Asclepius/sitemap.xml): canonical public routes.
